visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women with long dark hair sit on a white tiled ledge of an indoor swimming pool, facing away from the camera. They are dressed in oversized black t-shirts. Floating above them are three digital overlays of Pokemon trading cards: Alolan Exeggutor, Gyarados, and Pikachu. The background consists of a clear pool and large windows overlooking a bright exterior. (2) The screen is divided into a horizontal split. In the upper half, the three women turn their heads to smile and wave at the camera. In the lower half, three other women are seated in the pool water, laughing and interacting with each other. A large text overlay reads 'Which Pokémon is the best?' in the center. (3) The upper half shows the women turning back to face the pool. In the bottom half, the three women pose for the camera. A male bystander is visible in the background on the far right, sitting and holding a phone. The lighting remains bright and natural throughout the indoor spa environment. (4) The women in the top half perform a synchronized rhythmic movement of their hips. They are revealed to be wearing Pokemon-themed swimsuit bottoms: green with a leaf tail, blue with a curly tail, and orange with a flame tail. The camera remains static, capturing the high-contrast colors and the sharp, energetic movements of the group.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy Phonk electronic track begins immediately with a sharp, percussive cowbell melody and a heavily distorted bassline. The tempo is fast at approximately 140 BPM, creating a driving and aggressive rhythmic foundation. There are no human voices or environmental sounds audible. (2) The track continues with a steady four-on-the-floor kick drum and crisp electronic snare hits. The spectral brightness is elevated due to the sharp transients of the synthesizer. The mix is studio-clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio. (3) The repetitive Cowbell melody sustains the energy level without any harmonic shifts or pauses. The low-end bass remains thick and dominant, providing a consistent pulse that matches the anticipated visual reveal. (4) The audio sequence concludes with the final rhythmic bars of the loop. Each bass kick is highly percussive and perfectly synchronized with the physical movements on screen. The track ends with a hard cut, coinciding with the video's loop point.
